title: Competitive Mapping
description: List of genomes and associated data from Competitive Mapping.

genome_name.description: The name of the reference genome

length.description: Total length of genome, taken from reference data

coverage.description: Genome coverage derived from `sum(contig coverage * contig length) / length`

numreads.description: Number of reads mapped to the genome (sum of reads over contigs)

meandepth.description: Depth derived from `sum(contig meandepth * contig length / length)`
